limitations: This diagnoses numerical parity for one forced-width update; it is not a quality evaluation.
The profiler adds overhead, so elapsed seconds are not throughput measurements.
A passing gate does not authorize training, blocking, registry promotion, or deployment.

measurement.compiler_cache: isolated empty temporary directory per mode and replica
measurement.profiler_scope: the exact loss/backward pass whose gradients are compared

privacy: Only scalar losses, aggregate token and numerical summaries, parameter names/shapes, compiler counters, profiler event names/counts, and gradient hashes are emitted. Prompt text, row identity, predictions, and gradient vectors are omitted.

recipe.dropout: disabled via eval for correctness comparison
recipe.float32_matmul_precision: high with CUDA and cuDNN TF32 enabled

workload.selection: top 4096 raw-character candidates per population, reranked by strict-normalized tokenizer width measured through 1025 tokens
